instrument: New Mexico State Land Office denials of right-of-way for the Green Chile gas pipeline (Transwestern / Energy Transfer)
summary: The Commissioner of Public Lands twice denied Transwestern Pipeline a right-of-way across about 0.6 mile of state trust land for the roughly 17-mile Green Chile pipeline that would fuel the Project Jupiter campus's on-site fuel cells: in March 2026 and again on July 14, 2026. The FERC-filed in-service date moved from Aug 15, 2026 to Feb 1, 2027.

source.citation: El Paso Matters (Sept 24, 2026); Source NM (July 16, Aug 17, 2026) as cited in secondary coverage

notes: Reported grounds: the pipeline would not benefit state trust land (El Paso Matters); emissions and strain on water and local resources (other coverage). On Sept 24, 2026 Oracle sent a force majeure notice to the developer (Stack Infrastructure / Blue Owl); Oracle says the project remains on schedule. Pipeline length reported as 17 to 18 miles.

next.event: Green Chile pipeline revised in-service date (Project Jupiter)
